lead_raw_text:
The structure of CaZrFeO₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Fe and Zr centers as tetrahedral, each coordinated by four O neighbors, while Ca adopts a 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangement and two O orbits each show two Fe/Zr neighbors. Corner-sharing between Fe and Zr tetrahedra is observed, alongside face-sharing between Ca and Fe or Zr polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
